name: WWK
verdict: WWK Lebensversicherung a.G., a Munich mutual insurance association owned by its members. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Mutual insurer (Versicherungsverein auf Gegenseitigkeit) founded 1884 in Munich; owned by its members, not shareholders or the state (wwk.de Unternehmensprofil). FC Augsburg's shirt sponsor since 2015/16, also holds the WWK Arena naming rights. No sourced human-rights finding against the group was found.
